+## 8. Real GEE Satellite Metadata to Raster Export Pipeline Connection
+
+### Architecture Analysis: Catalog Acquisition vs. Raster Export
+- **Catalog Metadata Acquisition (`POST /api/satellite/acquire`)**:
+  - Implements M3 multi-satellite catalog discovery across Sentinel-2, Landsat-8/9, and Sentinel-1.
+  - Queries Google Earth Engine REST API (`:listImages`), evaluates cloud coverage, clips to zone boundaries, and indexes metadata into MongoDB.
+  - Intentionally lightweight and fast: stores metadata in MongoDB with `processingStatus: ACQUIRED` (or `CATALOG_ACQUIRED`) without triggering compute-heavy multi-band raster exports on every query.
+- **Explicit Raster Export Pipeline (`POST /api/satellite/:id/export`)**:
+  - Connects the selected real satellite metadata record to the existing production export pipeline (`GeeExportService`, `GeeTaskService`, `GoogleDriveService`, `GeoTiffService`).
+  - Follows strict semantic stage progression without skip or simulated values.
+
+### Semantic Stage Pipeline
+```
+CATALOG_ACQUIRED (or ACQUIRED)
+        ↓
+EXPORT_REQUESTED (POST /api/satellite/:id/export initiated)
+        ↓
+EXPORT_RUNNING (Real GEE v1alpha REST image:export task submitted)
+        ↓
+EXPORT_COMPLETED (GEE task state polled until COMPLETED)
+        ↓
+DRIVE_FILE_FOUND (File located in Google Drive, size > 0 bytes verified)
+        ↓
+DOWNLOADED (GeoTIFF streamed to local disk)
+        ↓
+RASTER_VALIDATED (Dimensions, bands, metric CRS normalized, pixel scale validated)
+        ↓
+PROCESSED (Spectral indices NDVI, NDWI, NDBI calculated)
+```
+
+### System Changes

+   - Added export metadata tracking fields to [`SatelliteMetadata.ts`](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/models/SatelliteMetadata.ts):
+     `geeExportTaskId`, `driveFileId`, `driveFileName`, `driveFileSizeBytes`, `localRasterPath`, `rasterValidated`, `rasterWidth`, `rasterHeight`, `rasterBandCount`, `originalCrs`, `rasterCrs`, `areaCalculationCrs`, `pixelAreaM2`, `resolutionMeters`, `spectralIndicesCalculated`, `pipelineCompletedAt`, `failureReason`.
+2. **Backend Service & Route**:
+   - Implemented `exportSatelliteRaster(metadataId, options)` in [`SatelliteAcquisitionService.ts`](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/services/SatelliteAcquisitionService.ts).
+   - Added `exportImage` controller in [`SatelliteController.ts`](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/controllers/SatelliteController.ts).
+   - Registered `POST /api/satellite/:id/export` route in [`satellite.routes.ts`](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/routes/satellite.routes.ts).
